items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Bob Stewart with me today.

ctx.x: Bob was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 24, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Bob Stewart with me today. And I said to you a moment ago, you’re my first tuba interview. We have one banjo player and now we have a tuba player.
